  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['f24'], df['f25'] + df['f26'], rtol=1e-5)"
      ],
      "features": ["f24", "f25", "f26"],
      "rationale": "f24 is defined as the sum of f25 and f26."
    },
    {
      "id": "R2",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['f42'] == ((df['x00'] == df['x02']) & (df['x01'] == df['x03']))"
      ],
      "features": ["f42", "x00", "x01", "x02", "x03"],
      "rationale": "f42 is binary indicating if source and destination IP and port are equal."
    },
    {
      "id": "R3",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['f12'], (df['f07'] * 8) / df['f01'], rtol=1e-5)"
      ],
      "features": ["f12", "f07", "f01"],
      "rationale": "Source bits per second derived from source bytes and duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "R4",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['f13'], (df['f08'] * 8) / df['f01'], rtol=1e-5)"
      ],
      "features": ["f13", "f08", "f01"],
      "rationale": "Destination bits per second derived from destination bytes and duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "R5",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['f27'], df['f07'] / df['f05'], rtol=1e-5)",
        "df['f27'] == (df['f07'] // df['f05'])"
      ],
      "features": ["f27", "f07", "f05"],
      "rationale": "Mean packet size is total bytes divided by packet count, possibly integer division."
    },
    {
      "id": "R6",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['f28'], df['f08'] / df['f06'], rtol=1e-5)",
        "df['f28'] == (df['f08'] // df['f06'])"
      ],
      "features": ["f28", "f08", "f06"],
      "rationale": "Mean packet size is total bytes divided by packet count, possibly integer division."
    },
    {
      "id": "R7",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['f05'] > 1, np.isclose(df['f16'], df['f01'] / (df['f05'] - 1), rtol=1e-5), True)",
        "np.where(df['f05'] > 1, np.isclose(df['f16'], (df['f01'] * 1000) / (df['f05'] - 1), rtol=1e-5), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["f16", "f01", "f05"],
      "rationale": "Interpacket arrival time is average time between packets, derived from duration and packet count, with possible unit scaling."
    },
    {
      "id": "R8",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['f06'] > 1, np.isclose(df['f17'], df['f01'] / (df['f06'] - 1), rtol=1e-5), True)",
        "np.where(df['f06'] > 1, np.isclose(df['f17'], (df['f01'] * 1000) / (df['f06'] - 1), rtol=1e-5), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["f17", "f01", "f06"],
      "rationale": "Interpacket arrival time is average time between packets, derived from duration and packet count, with possible unit scaling."
    },
    {
      "id": "R9",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['f09'], df['f07'] + df['f08'], rtol=1e-5)",
        "np.isclose(df['f09'], (df['f07'] + df['f08']) / (df['f05'] + df['f06']), rtol=1e-5)",
        "np.isclose(df['f09'], df['f01'] * (df['f12'] + df['f13']) / 8, rtol=1e-5)"
      ],
      "features": ["f09", "f07", "f08", "f05", "f06", "f01", "f12", "f13"],
      "rationale": "f09 is undocumented; plausible definitions include total bytes, overall mean packet size, or derived from bit rates."
    }
  ]
